mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tb_booking_pass_order WHERE status=1 AND booking_pass_type_snapshot=0 AND expire_at<=NOW(3) ORDER BY expire_at,id LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_booking_pass_order SET expire_at=TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE,#{timeoutMinutes},NOW(3)) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status=1 AND booking_pass_type_snapshot=0 AND expire_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT user_id,status+0 AS status,booking_pass_type_snapshot,expire_at,CAST(expire_at<=NOW(3) AS SIGNED) AS due FROM tb_booking_pass_order WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_booking_pass_order SET status=4 WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status=1 AND expire_at<=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM tb_ordinary_order_slot WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND booking_pass_id=#{bookingPassId} FOR UPDATE
